rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Do you know what I want more
than anything else right now?

rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0003
rows.name: No. A guarantee that I'll survive.

rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I think that the way things
are going, Alst as we know it
will be coming to an end.

rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0005
rows.name:
The Divine Beasts gathered together
and started fighting each other...

rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0006
rows.name:
There's no guarantee any of us
will make it out of this alive.

rows.label: tlk43600142_03_msg0007
rows.name:
If money could save my life, I'd pay
every last bit of my fortune.
